headlines.title: Multiple earthquakes, including a 5.0, strike near Pinnacles
headlines.description: Multiple earthquakes struck near Pinnacles on Thursday night, according to the United States Geological Survey. The strongest was a 5.0 magnitude earthquake that hit at 10:40 p.m. It was centered 6.2 miles northwest of Pinnacles, according to the USGS. According to the USGS, that earthquake was followed by two 2.5 quakes of magnitude 2.5, another of magnitude 3.4, a fourth of magnitude 2.6 and fifth quake of magnitude 2.7. Two other earthquakes of magnitude 2.6, followed by another of magnitude 2.5, also struck the area, according to the USGS. A tsunami is not expected, according to authorities. This is a developing story. Details may change as more information becomes available. Stay tuned for updates.
